title: Print the it_companies list
description:
Print the list using print().

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as printed_it_companies(companies), returning the exact string that print(companies) would write to the screen.
hints: print() shows a list using the same text you'd get from converting it to a string.
str() applied to a list produces exactly that text, with brackets, commas and quoted strings.
expected_behavior: Returns the string representation of the companies list, matching what print() would output.
explanation: str() on a list produces the same text that print() writes to the screen, so returning str(companies) mirrors what printing the list would show.
